strategy: The robot follows a prioritized decision-making strategy to navigate toward its goal while avoiding obstacles. It first checks for safe goal-directed movements (goal ahead, left, or right) and attempts to move in that direction if the corresponding path is unblocked. If no direct goal path is available, it tries to move forward, then left, then right, based on which direction is unblocked. If all directions are blocked, it stops safely.

decisions.reason: The goal is ahead and the forward path is unblocked, so move forward.
The goal is on the left and the left path is unblocked, so turn left.
The goal is on the right and the right path is unblocked, so turn right.
No direct goal-directed movement was possible, but forward path is unblocked, so move forward.
No direct goal-directed movement was possible, but left path is unblocked, so turn left.
No direct goal-directed movement was possible, but right path is unblocked, so turn right.
All directions are blocked and no safe path exists, so stop safely.

stop_condition: The robot must stop when all forward, left, and right paths are blocked to ensure safety.
